description: One line of ripple's rulings log, version 1, at .neo/ripple/rulings.jsonl in the library. The log is event-sourced: the newest line for an id is that id's state. A job is one source page at one state of its text; a proposal is one thing the judge proposed for a job, and its status is the author's ruling; the cursor says how far reconcile has read the change log and git.

page.title: RipplePage
page.description: A page of the library: a chapter of a book, with the title it had then.

hop.description: 0 for a change the author made or imported; one more for each change ripple made on the way. Ripple opens no job past hop 2.

state.description: open: no packet yet. packeted: waiting for the judge. judged: the judge's proposals are in the log. skipped: the author set it aside.

origin.description: What made the job: an import, a change in git, the author's Ripple This Chapter, or an earlier ripple.

commit.description: The library's HEAD when the job was made, where the quotes are checked.

parent.description: The proposal whose change made this job.

problem.description: Why the judge's answer could not be taken, while it cannot.

status.description: proposed: waiting for the author. A nothing is rejected as it arrives: the judge declined the page, and that is recorded as a decision.

target.description: The page a nothing, claim or topic is about, or the title a mint makes.

quote.description: The source's words the proposal rests on.

anchor.description: A claim's words on the target page now.

text.description: A claim's new words, or a mint's first passage.

line.description: The line a topic adds to the target page.

outcome.description: How an applied proposal landed: written by the librarian, made a suggestion or a comment for the author, or minted as a new page.

delta.description: Why it was deferred, or a word on how it landed.

commit.description: The librarian's commit holding the change, when there is one.
The commit reconcile read git up to.

changes.description: How many lines of .neo/changes.jsonl reconcile has read.
